trials.claim: Lifetime deal unlocks all product downloads based on purchased membership model
trials.claimQuote: If you have a Lifetime deal or a Subscription (coming soon), all product downloads will be unlocked based on the membership model you purchased.
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports templates occasionally drop off the site and advises downloading promptly, which materially limits the promise that all downloads remain unlocked under the purchased membership.

exhibits.quote: One downside is that templates seem to drop off the site occasionally so buy, visit often, and download what interests you!
exhibits.argument: Templates disappearing contradicts the promise that all downloads stay unlocked by membership.

trials.claim: Each template download includes a help file for contents and customization
trials.claimQuote: Each template download includes a help file explaining the contents and customization options.
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm templates include helpful instructions and clear explanations for modifying them, with no exhibit undercutting this.

exhibits.quote: The templates come with helpful instructions which made it even easier to use.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms templates come with helpful instructions that aid use.

exhibits.quote: Each template I've tried is well built with clear explanations as to how to modify them for one's purpose.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms each template includes clear explanations for modification.

trials.claim: Font differences in PowerPoint may require installing correct fonts
trials.claimQuote: If the fonts appear differently in PowerPoint, you may need to install the correct fonts on your system.
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted about font differences or needing to install fonts.

trials.claim: Templates are versatile and highly customizable for comprehensive presentations
trials.claimQuote: Graphue's templates are versatile and highly customizable, suitable for various situations requiring a comprehensive presentation.
trials.reasoning: The defense shows variety and professional quality but does not directly show high customizability, while the single 'simple templates' criticism is too vague to directly contradict versatility.

exhibits.quote: What I found is that they are nothing more than simple PowerPoint templates.
exhibits.argument: Calling them nothing more than simple templates undermines the versatile and highly customizable claim.

exhibits.quote: I really like that you seem to have a template for each and every business and situation.
exhibits.argument: Vendor testimonial states there is a template for each business and situation.

exhibits.quote: Graphue is a great resource for those looking for beautiful presentation templates that are carefully crafted to be engaging and professional.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms templates are engaging, professional and versatile.

trials.claim: You can edit colors, fonts, images, and slides to fit needs
trials.claimQuote: You can edit colors, fonts, images, and slides to fit your specific needs.
trials.reasoning: Buyers directly confirm format, colors, fonts and every object are configurable and easy to customize; complaints about supplying stock photos do not prevent editing or replacing images.

exhibits.quote: The slides show images, but in reality, you have to download and upload all those images yourself
exhibits.argument: Having to supply all images yourself undermines the claim you can simply edit images to fit needs.

exhibits.quote: I downloaded one template and realized it comes with zero stock photos
exhibits.argument: Zero stock photos included undermines the claim that images are editable as provided.

exhibits.quote: A lot of styles to choose from and beyond that they are basically configurable in format, colors, fonts... every object is available for customization.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms colors, fonts and format objects are configurable and customizable.

exhibits.quote: These templates are great quality and easy to customize.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms templates are easy to customize.

trials.claim: Templates can be used for commercial projects with purchased commercial license
trials.claimQuote: Yes, with a purchased commercial license, you can use Graphue's templates for commercial projects.
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm commercial use with purchase and stacking for the agency model; needing extra codes for agency licensing does not contradict commercial use under a purchased commercial license.

exhibits.quote: I purchased a code and then read that I need to buy 2 additional codes for the agency licensing.
exhibits.argument: Requiring two extra codes undermines the claim a purchased commercial license alone covers commercial use.

exhibits.quote: It's a no-brainer for $49 with unlimited commercial use.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms purchase includes unlimited commercial use.

exhibits.quote: I bought this and stacked for the agency model!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms stacking purchase for agency licensing model.
